notes: Hangar = Level(mode 0x17), CutScene(0x17). Every static is PlayerStatic(-1, AEGeometry(id), (0,0,0)) with AEGeometry::setRotation(0, pi, 0) (0x40490fdb). Statics live in the enemies list, so their keyframe animation (*_anim_add) is advanced every frame by CutScene::process (Transform::Update(dt)); no explicit animation state. The x1..xN props (+shadow_alpha) get no transform of their own (placement is baked in the mesh). The loop adds a fresh copy under each static (so the original renders them up to 3x). hangar_terran_bot_*_anim(+_add) meshes have resource ids but NO code creates them (CutScene+0x38 bot array is never filled). Remake: the four bots (hangar_terran_bot_a..d_anim + _add, the beta's) are placed like the room's other layers and drive their keyed loop (StationLevel.BuildHangar).
